import PV_L2C_ComputedDigestRange
import R1Z.BuilderRecordCanonical
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_L2C_ChunkRange
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0Z.WriterRefine

theorem note2 (v a : U32) (s : Array U32 8#usize)
    (hv : v.val < 2147483647) (ha : a.val < 2147483647) (hs : Canon8 s) :
    Canon8 (noteC2R v a s) := by
  intro j hj
  rw [noteC2R,arr8_get _ j hj]
  dsimp only
  split_ifs with h0 h1
  · exact hv
  · exact ha
  · exact hs (j-2) (by omega)
#print axioms note2

theorem note3 (s : Array U32 8#usize) (hs : Canon8 s) : Canon8 (noteC3R s) := by
  intro j hj
  rw [noteC3R,arr8_get _ j hj]
  dsimp only
  split_ifs
  · exact hs 6 (by omega)
  · exact hs 7 (by omega)
  · change 0 < 2147483647;omega
#print axioms note3

theorem chunks (w : RustWitness) (p : RustPublic)
    (hw : R1Z.BuilderRecordCanonical.CanonicalWords w) (ha : p.asset.val < 2147483647)
    (h : Nat) : Canon8 ((chunksOf w p).schunk h) := by
  change Canon8 (if h = 0 ∨ h = 25 then w.sk else if h = 1 then okOr (ownerD w) zero8 else if h = 2 then noteC2R w.inputValue p.asset w.salt else if h = 3 then noteC3R w.salt else if h = 26 then w.salt else if h = 27 then w.recipientOwner else if h = 28 then noteC2R w.outputValue p.asset w.recipientSalt else if h = 29 then noteC3R w.recipientSalt else if h = 30 then w.changeOwner else if h = 31 then noteC2R w.changeValue p.asset w.changeSalt else if h = 32 then noteC3R w.changeSalt else zero8)
  by_cases h0 : h = 0 ∨ h = 25
  · rw [if_pos h0]
    exact hw.sk
  rw [if_neg h0]
  by_cases h1 : h = 1
  · rw [if_pos h1]
    exact PV_L2C_ComputedDigestRange.fallback _ (PV_L2C_ComputedDigestRange.owner w)
  rw [if_neg h1]
  by_cases h2 : h = 2
  · rw [if_pos h2]
    exact note2 _ _ _ (by have := hw.shape.values.1;omega) ha hw.salt
  rw [if_neg h2]
  by_cases h3 : h = 3
  · rw [if_pos h3]
    exact note3 _ hw.salt
  rw [if_neg h3]
  by_cases h4 : h = 26
  · rw [if_pos h4]
    exact hw.salt
  rw [if_neg h4]
  by_cases h5 : h = 27
  · rw [if_pos h5]
    exact hw.recipientOwner
  rw [if_neg h5]
  by_cases h6 : h = 28
  · rw [if_pos h6]
    exact note2 _ _ _ (by have := hw.shape.values.2.1;omega) ha hw.recipientSalt
  rw [if_neg h6]
  by_cases h7 : h = 29
  · rw [if_pos h7]
    exact note3 _ hw.recipientSalt
  rw [if_neg h7]
  by_cases h8 : h = 30
  · rw [if_pos h8]
    exact hw.changeOwner
  rw [if_neg h8]
  by_cases h9 : h = 31
  · rw [if_pos h9]
    exact note2 _ _ _ (by have := hw.shape.values.2.2;omega) ha hw.changeSalt
  rw [if_neg h9]
  by_cases h10 : h = 32
  · rw [if_pos h10]
    exact note3 _ hw.changeSalt
  rw [if_neg h10]
  exact zero8_canon
#print axioms chunks

theorem ordered (a b : Array U32 8#usize) (bit : Bool) (ha : Canon8 a) (hb : Canon8 b) :
    Canon8 (orderedR a b bit).1 ∧ Canon8 (orderedR a b bit).2 := by
  cases bit
  · exact ⟨ha,hb⟩
  · exact ⟨hb,ha⟩
#print axioms ordered

theorem children (w : RustWitness) (p : RustPublic) (hw : WitnessOk w)
    (hf : ∀ n, n < 20 → Canon8 (p.frontier.val[n]!))
    (he : ∀ n, n < 20 → Canon8 (p.empty.val[n]!))
    (h : Nat) (hh : h < 57) :
    Canon8 (childrenOf w p h).1 ∧ Canon8 (childrenOf w p h).2 := by
  unfold childrenOf
  split_ifs with hm hhi hout happ
  · exact ordered _ _ _ (PV_L2C_ComputedDigestRange.fallback _
      (PV_L2C_ComputedDigestRange.tree w p _)) (hw.sibs _ (by omega))
  · exact ordered _ _ _ (PV_L2C_ComputedDigestRange.fallback _
      (PV_L2C_ComputedDigestRange.tree w p _)) (hw.sibs _ (by omega))
  · cases p.variant
    · exact ⟨PV_L2C_ComputedDigestRange.fallback _ (PV_L2C_ComputedDigestRange.note _ _),
        PV_L2C_ComputedDigestRange.fallback _ (PV_L2C_ComputedDigestRange.note _ _)⟩
    · exact ⟨PV_L2C_ComputedDigestRange.fallback _ (PV_L2C_ComputedDigestRange.note _ _),zero8_canon⟩
  · apply ordered _ _ _ (PV_L2C_ComputedDigestRange.fallback _
      (PV_L2C_ComputedDigestRange.append w p _))
    unfold appSibR
    split_ifs
    · exact hf _ (by omega)
    · exact he _ (by omega)
  · exact ⟨zero8_canon,zero8_canon⟩
#print axioms children
end PV_L2C_ChunkRange

import PV_L2C_BlockRange
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_L2C_WriterEndsRange
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0Z.WriterRefine PV_L2C_BlockRange

theorem init (domain len : U32) (hd : domain.val < 2147483647)
    (hl : len.val < 2147483647) (s : Array U32 16#usize)
    (hs : R0BlockCopies.sponge_init domain len = ok s) : Canonical s := by
  obtain ⟨expected,he,hcells⟩ := sponge_init_spec domain len
  have same : s = expected := Result.ok.inj (hs.symm.trans he)
  intro j hj
  rw [same,hcells]
  split_ifs
  · exact hd
  · exact hl
  · change 0 < 2147483647;omega
#print axioms init

theorem absorb (chunk : Array U32 8#usize) (len : Usize)
    (hc : Canon8 chunk) (s : Array U32 16#usize)
    (hs : R0BlockCopies.sponge_absorb chunk len = ok s) : Canonical s := by
  obtain ⟨expected,he,hcells⟩ := sponge_absorb_spec chunk len
  have same : s = expected := Result.ok.inj (hs.symm.trans he)
  intro j hj
  rw [same,hcells]
  split_ifs with hit
  · exact hc j hit.1
  · change 0 < 2147483647;omega
#print axioms absorb

theorem node_pre (right : Array U32 8#usize) (hc : Canon8 right)
    (s : Array U32 16#usize) (hs : R0BlockCopies.node_pre right = ok s) : Canonical s := by
  obtain ⟨expected,he,hcells⟩ := node_pre_spec right hc
  have same : s = expected := Result.ok.inj (hs.symm.trans he)
  intro j hj
  rw [same,hcells]
  have h7 := hc 7 (by omega)
  split_ifs with h8 h15 hsub h16
  · omega
  · omega
  · omega
  · exact hc (j-8) (by omega)
  · omega
#print axioms node_pre

theorem node_absorb (left : Array U32 8#usize) (hc : Canon8 left)
    (s : Array U32 16#usize) (hs : R0BlockCopies.node_absorb left = ok s) : Canonical s := by
  obtain ⟨expected,he,hcells⟩ := node_absorb_spec left
  have same : s = expected := Result.ok.inj (hs.symm.trans he)
  intro j hj
  rw [same,hcells]
  split_ifs with h8
  · exact hc j h8
  · change 0 < 2147483647;omega
#print axioms node_absorb
end PV_L2C_WriterEndsRange

import PV_L2C_WriterEndsRange
import PV_L2C_ChunkRange
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_L2C_WriterChainRange
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0Z.WriterRefine PV_L2C_BlockRange

theorem pre (r : RustChunks) (n : Nat) (s : Array U32 16#usize)
    (hs : spongePre r n = ok s) : Canonical s := by
  unfold spongePre at hs
  split at hs
  all_goals first
  | exact PV_L2C_WriterEndsRange.init _ _ (by scalar_tac) (by scalar_tac) s hs
  | (pv_peel hs with prior hp
     exact sponge_step _ _ _ _ hs)
  | (pv_peel hs with prior hp
     pv_peel hs with prior2 hp2
     exact sponge_step _ _ _ _ hs)
  | (cases hs; exact zeros 16#usize)
#print axioms pre

theorem chain (v : R0P.Variant) (r : RustChunks) (n : Nat)
    (hl : Canon8 (r.left n)) (hr : Canon8 (r.right n)) (hc : Canon8 (r.schunk n))
    (b : Array U32 256#usize) (hb : RustWriterChain v r n = ok b) : Canonical b := by
  unfold RustWriterChain at hb
  split_ifs at hb with hn hz
  · pv_peel hb with pre hp
    pv_peel hb with ab ha
    pv_peel hb with rounds hrounds
    exact block pre ab rounds b (PV_L2C_WriterEndsRange.node_pre _ hr _ hp)
      (PV_L2C_WriterEndsRange.node_absorb _ hl _ ha) hrounds hb
  · pv_peel hb with rounds hrounds
    exact block zero16 zero16 rounds b (zeros 16#usize) (zeros 16#usize) hrounds hb
  · pv_peel hb with spre hp
    pv_peel hb with ab ha
    pv_peel hb with rounds hrounds
    exact block spre ab rounds b (pre r n spre hp)
      (PV_L2C_WriterEndsRange.absorb _ _ hc _ ha) hrounds hb
#print axioms chain

theorem records (w : RustWitness) (p : RustPublic)
    (hw : R1Z.BuilderRecordCanonical.CanonicalWords w) (ha : p.asset.val < 2147483647)
    (hf : ∀ n, n < 20 → Canon8 (p.frontier.val[n]!))
    (he : ∀ n, n < 20 → Canon8 (p.empty.val[n]!))
    (n : Nat) (hn : n < 57) (b : Array U32 256#usize)
    (hb : RustWriterChain p.variant (rustChunks w p) n = ok b) : Canonical b := by
  have hchildren := PV_L2C_ChunkRange.children w p hw.shape hf he n hn
  exact chain _ _ _ hchildren.1 hchildren.2 (PV_L2C_ChunkRange.chunks w p hw ha n) b hb
#print axioms records
end PV_L2C_WriterChainRange

import PV_L2C_BlockRange
import R0Z.WriterRefinePathBlock
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_L2C_PathRange
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0Z.WriterRefine PV_L2C_BlockRange

theorem cell (bit dflt : U32) (cur left right : Array U32 8#usize) (lev k : Nat)
    (hb : bit.val < 2147483647) (hd : dflt.val < 2147483647)
    (hc : Canon8 cur) (hl : Canon8 left) (hr : Canon8 right) :
    (PV bit cur left right lev dflt k).val < 2147483647 := by
  unfold PV
  split_ifs with h0 h1 h2 h3
  · exact hb
  · exact hc _ (by omega)
  · exact hl _ (by omega)
  · exact hr _ (by omega)
  · exact hd
#print axioms cell

theorem loop (bits : Array U32 24#usize)
    (cur left right : Array (Array U32 8#usize) 24#usize)
    (hb : ∀ j, j < 24 → (bits.val[j]!).val < 2147483647)
    (hc : ∀ j, j < 24 → Canon8 (cur.val[j]!))
    (hl : ∀ j, j < 24 → Canon8 (left.val[j]!))
    (hr : ∀ j, j < 24 → Canon8 (right.val[j]!))
    (n : Nat) (lev : Usize) (buf out : Array U32 1536#usize)
    (hn : lev.val+n = 24) (hbuf : Canonical buf)
    (hout : R0WriterCopies.write_path_block_loop bits cur left right buf lev = ok out) :
    Canonical out := by
  obtain ⟨expected,he,hcells⟩ := path_block_loop bits cur left right n lev buf hn
  have same : out = expected := Result.ok.inj (hout.symm.trans he)
  intro k hk
  rw [same,hcells]
  split_ifs with hit
  · exact cell _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (hb _ hit.2.2) (hbuf k hk)
      (hc _ hit.2.2) (hl _ hit.2.2) (hr _ hit.2.2)
  · exact hbuf k hk
#print axioms loop
end PV_L2C_PathRange

import PV_L2C_BlockRange
import R0Z.WriterRefineValueModel
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_L2C_ValueRange
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0Z.WriterRefine PV_L2C_BlockRange

theorem outer (vals : Nat → Nat) (blk : Nat → Nat) (start k : Nat)
    (hv : ∀ j, j < 3 → vals j < 2147483647) (hb : blk k < 2147483647) :
    OuterVal vals start blk k < 2147483647 := by
  unfold OuterVal
  split_ifs with hit hbit hvalue
  · have := Nat.mod_lt (vals (jOf (k/16)) / 2^tOf (2*jOf (k/16)) k) (by omega : 0 < 2)
    omega
  · exact hv _ hit.1
  · exact hb
  · exact hb
#print axioms outer

theorem final (vals : Nat → Nat) (hv : ∀ j, j < 3 → vals j < 2^30) (k : Nat) :
    FinalVal vals k < 2147483647 := by
  have h0 := hv 0 (by omega)
  have h1 := hv 1 (by omega)
  have h2 := hv 2 (by omega)
  unfold FinalVal
  split_ifs
  all_goals first | omega | exact outer vals (fun _ => 0) 0 k (by intro j hj;have := hv j hj;omega) (by omega)
#print axioms final

theorem block (values : Array U32 3#usize) (hv : ∀ j, j < 3 → (values.val[j]!).val < 2^30)
    (out : Array U32 256#usize) (hout : R0WriterCopies.write_value_block values = ok out) :
    Canonical out := by
  obtain ⟨expected,he,hcells⟩ := value_block values hv
  have same : out = expected := Result.ok.inj (hout.symm.trans he)
  intro k hk
  rw [same,hcells]
  exact final _ hv k
#print axioms block
end PV_L2C_ValueRange

import PV_L2C_BlockRange
import R0Z.WriterRefineOccRow
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_L2C_OccRange
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0Z.WriterRefine PV_L2C_BlockRange

structure Fields (o : R0WriterCopies.OccRecord) : Prop where
  occupied : o.occupied.val < 2147483647
  inverse : o.inverse.val < 2147483647
  commitment : Canon8 o.commitment
  selected : o.has_selected = true → o.selected.val < 2147483647

theorem cell (o : R0WriterCopies.OccRecord) (ho : Fields o) (c : Nat) (d : U32)
    (hd : d.val < 2147483647) : ((occRowCell o c).getD d).val < 2147483647 := by
  unfold occRowCell
  split_ifs with h0 h1 h2 h3
  · exact ho.occupied
  · exact ho.inverse
  · exact ho.commitment (c-2) (by omega)
  · exact ho.selected h3.2
  · exact hd
#print axioms cell

theorem row (buf : Array U32 256#usize) (hbuf : Canonical buf)
    (r : Usize) (hr : r.val ≤ 15) (o : R0WriterCopies.OccRecord) (ho : Fields o)
    (out : Array U32 256#usize) (hout : R0WriterCopies.write_occupancy_row buf r o = ok out) :
    Canonical out := by
  obtain ⟨expected,he,hcells⟩ := occ_row buf r hr o
  have same : out = expected := Result.ok.inj (hout.symm.trans he)
  intro k hk
  rw [same,hcells]
  split_ifs
  · exact cell o ho _ _ (hbuf k hk)
  · exact hbuf k hk
#print axioms row
end PV_L2C_OccRange

import PV_L2C_DigestOrigin
import PV_L2C_BlockRange
import R1Z.PV_RunJoin_UniversalRecords22
import R1Z.BuilderRecordCanonical
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace PV_L2C_RecordRange
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0Z.WriterRefine R1Z PV_Src_NativeInput

/-- Raw field facts supplied by successful input validation and the output
origin route. No trace cell or prover guard appears in this interface. -/
structure Fields (i : Input) : Prop where
  key : Canon8 i.witness.pair.nullifier_key
  salt : Canon8 i.witness.pair.salt
  occupied : i.witness.pair.pair_leaf.second_occupied.val < 2147483647
  inverse : i.witness.pair.pair_leaf.second_occupancy_inverse.val < 2147483647
  recipient : ∀ note, recipient i.request = some note →
    PV_L2C_DigestOrigin.Origin note.owner_key ∧ PV_L2C_DigestOrigin.Origin note.salt
  changeOwner : PV_L2C_DigestOrigin.Origin i.change.owner_key
  changeSalt : PV_L2C_DigestOrigin.Origin i.change.salt

theorem optional_owner (rec : Option BuilderRecordsReference.Note)
    (hc : ∀ r, rec = some r → Canon8 r.owner_key) :
    Canon8 (BuilderRecordsRecipient.owner rec) := by
  cases rec with
  | none =>
    intro j hj
    exact PV_L2C_BlockRange.zeros 8#usize j (by simpa using hj)
  | some r => exact hc r rfl
#print axioms optional_owner

theorem optional_salt (rec : Option BuilderRecordsReference.Note)
    (hc : ∀ r, rec = some r → Canon8 r.salt) :
    Canon8 (BuilderRecordsRecipient.salt rec) := by
  cases rec with
  | none =>
    intro j hj
    exact PV_L2C_BlockRange.zeros 8#usize j (by simpa using hj)
  | some r => exact hc r rfl
#print axioms optional_salt

theorem records (i : Input) (checked : PV_Src_RecordReference.Checked i)
    (hf : Fields i) :
    BuilderRecordCanonical.CanonicalWords
      (PV_Src_Forest_PrimitiveArguments.wordWitness
        (PV_Src_RecordReference.returned PV_Src_CanonicalRoots.table i).w) := by
  have shape := PV_RunJoin_UniversalRecords22.words i checked _
    (PV_RunJoin_UniversalRecords22.newRecords i)
  refine ⟨shape,hf.key,hf.salt,checked.first,hf.occupied,checked.second,hf.inverse,
    ?_,?_,PV_L2C_DigestOrigin.canonical _ hf.changeOwner,
    PV_L2C_DigestOrigin.canonical _ hf.changeSalt⟩
  · apply optional_owner
    intro r he
    cases hrec : recipient i.request with
    | none => simp only [hrec,Option.map_none] at he;cases he
    | some actual =>
      simp only [hrec,Option.map_some] at he
      cases Option.some.inj he
      exact PV_L2C_DigestOrigin.canonical _ (hf.recipient actual hrec).1
  · apply optional_salt
    intro r he
    cases hrec : recipient i.request with
    | none => simp only [hrec,Option.map_none] at he;cases he
    | some actual =>
      simp only [hrec,Option.map_some] at he
      cases Option.some.inj he
      exact PV_L2C_DigestOrigin.canonical _ (hf.recipient actual hrec).2
#print axioms records
end PV_L2C_RecordRange
